title: NOT THE BEES!
description:
A cosmetic meme mod. When the Entomancer elite shuffles Dazed cards into your deck, each one becomes Nic Cage screaming under a cage of bees (The Wicker Man, 2006), renamed 'NOT THE BEES!'. Only the Entomancer's Dazed are affected; Dazed from any other source stays normal. No gameplay changes.

Also works around a game bug where loading any C# mod can freeze Slay the Spire 2 on startup.

Source: [url=https://github.com/brian-gates/STS2_NotTheBees]github.com/brian-gates/STS2_NotTheBees[/url]
changeNote: Fixes the startup freeze that could happen with mods loaded (a game-side Sentry bug), so installing from the Workshop is safe.
